name: jarvis-desktop
description: JARVIS Desktop — עוזר אישי קולי בעברית ל-Windows 11
author: Ori

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:zip: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
